catalog.name: BoundedBox
catalog.description: An infinitely customizable image annotation widget

catalog.name: Button
catalog.description: Trigger actions: queries, alerts, set variables etc.

catalog.name: FileButton
catalog.description: A button that triggers file selection. Label updates to show selected file count after selection.

catalog.name: LibraryComponent
catalog.description: Custom component from a deployed library

catalog.name: QrScanner
catalog.description: Scan QR codes and hold its data

catalog.name: ShadAreaChart
catalog.description: Area or line chart (trends over time)

catalog.name: ShadAvatar
catalog.description: Avatar or avatar group: names is one name, a comma-separated list, or an array of names or { name, src } (a photo per person); the first maxVisible show, the rest as a +N chip

catalog.name: ShadBarChart
catalog.description: Bar chart, vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked. highlight emphasises categories (an x value, a list, or 'first', 'last', 'max', 'min') and draws the other bars muted; categoryColors { Won: '#16a34a', Lost: '#dc2626' } colours each category's bars

catalog.name: ShadButtonGroup
catalog.description: Button group (attached buttons) from buttons [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconBolt', disabled?, variant? }] (label '' with an icon = icon-only). mode: 'actions' (each click fires onClick, exposed lastClicked), 'single' or 'multiple' (a segmented selection: exposed value, selected; onChange). Height 36px (sm 32px, lg 40px); add 22px for a label

catalog.name: ShadCalendar
catalog.description: Inline month calendar. mode single, multiple or range; defaultValue 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a list for multiple, [start, end] for range); markers [{ date, label?, color? }] draw dots under days (label on hover); minDate, maxDate, disabledDates, disabledDays ([0, 6] = weekends). Exposed value, selectedDate, selectedDates, startDate, endDate, visibleMonth ('YYYY-MM'), visibleStart, visibleEnd; events onSelect, onMonthChanged. One month is about 300px tall and 250px wide (fullWidth stretches the days)

catalog.name: ShadCardGrid
catalog.description: Grid of cards from data, for things with a face (recipes, products, listings, people, rooms, projects): each card shows an image when imageField is mapped (a row without a picture gets a tinted panel with the title's initials; no imageField, no picture area), an eyebrow (eyebrowField: a small caps line above the title, such as a category or a code), an avatar beside the title (avatarField: an image URL, else the initials of that field's text; for people and owners), title, subtitle, badges (badgeField, plus badgeFields for more: 'cuisine, diet', at most 4; each toned by its words: Available green, Low stock amber, Sold out red), a description (two lines), a progress bar (progressField: a percentage 0 to 100, as 42 or '42%') and a meta line (metaFields, a comma list; 'prep:{} min' puts the value in a label, 'serves:Serves' puts the label first). layout 'stacked' (image on top) or 'row' (image left, text right: listings, people, a compact catalogue). columns (a number, or 'auto' to fit cards of minCardWidth), imageAspect ('16/9', '4/3', '1/1'; stacked only), cardStyle 'elevated', 'outline' or 'flat'. A click selects the card (selectedItem, selectedItemId; onCardClicked). Height: grows with its rows (about 300px per row stacked with an image, 150px without or in rows)

catalog.name: ShadCarousel
catalog.description: Carousel of slides [{ image, title?, description?, link? }] (or image URLs) with arrows and dots, loop, autoplay (interval ms, pauses on hover), slidesPerView 1 to 4, aspectRatio ('16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9' or 'fill' to fill the widget's height), imageFit cover or contain, captions as an overlay or below. Exposed currentIndex, currentSlide and clickedSlide (with its index); events onSlideChanged, onSlideClicked (a slide's link also opens in a new tab); actions next, previous, goTo(index). Height follows the width and ratio (+28px for dots, +52px for captions below)

catalog.name: ShadChat
catalog.description: ToolJet UI 2.0 chat: the native Chat widget's properties, events, exposed values and actions in the pack's look. Message rows with an avatar (an image URL, else initials) and the sender's name; the user's turns sit on the right in an accent bubble, replies on the left with markdown (lists, tables, code). A new user turn moves near the top of the view and the reply grows below it; scrolled up, the view stays where the reader is and a Jump to latest button appears. loadingResponse shows a typing indicator, loadingHistory skeleton rows. A message is { message, type: 'message' (user) | 'response' | 'error', name, avatar, timestamp, messageId }. Wire onMessageSent to a query that reads components.<chat>.lastMessage.message and appends its answer with the appendHistory action ({ message, type: 'response' }), with setResponseLoading around it. Height: fixed (the messages scroll); give it 400 to 700px

catalog.name: ShadCircularProgress
catalog.description: Circular progress ring: value 0 to 100 (clamped), size and thickness (px), lineCap ('round', 'flat'), centerText ('value' shows 63%, 'custom' shows text, 'none') with an optional label under it; barColor (default: the primary), trackColor, textColor, labelColor styles. Height: the size (96px by default)

catalog.name: ShadColorPicker
catalog.description: Color picker: a swatch-and-hex field opening a popover with a saturation/hue picker, a hex input and preset swatches (array of hex). Exposes value (#rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa with allowAlpha), selectedColorRGB and selectedColorRGBA. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without

catalog.name: ShadCombobox
catalog.description: Combobox: a searchable single select (popover with a search box). options: plain values or [{ label, value, description?, icon? (Tabler name like IconUser, image URL or emoji), group?, disabled? }]; exposes value, selectedOption, searchText. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without; add 24px for help text

catalog.name: ShadComboChart
catalog.description: Bar and line chart on one axis pair: data [{ month: 'Jan', revenue: 42000, margin: 31 }], xField 'month', barFields 'revenue' (bars), lineFields 'margin' (lines), rightAxisFields 'margin' (those series on a second, right axis with its own rightAxisFormat, e.g. percent); stackBars, curve, dots, yAxisFormat number/currency/percent/compact. Height 240-340 px; clicking sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadCurrencyInput
catalog.description: Currency amount input: the currency sign inside the box, the amount formatted for the locale with Intl (1,250.00 in en-US, 1.250,00 in de-DE). Exposes value (a number, null when empty), formattedValue ('$1,250.00') and currency ('USD'). currency is an ISO code; currencyOptions (['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP']) adds a currency picker at the start of the box; decimalPlaces empty uses the currency's own (JPY 0). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

catalog.name: ShadDatePicker
catalog.description: Date picker (popover calendar), single date or range. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

catalog.name: ShadDateTimePicker
catalog.description: Date and time picker: a field opening a calendar with a time row (hour, minute every minuteStep, AM/PM). Exposes value as 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' (local time, '' when empty), selectedDate 'YYYY-MM-DD', selectedTime 'HH:mm', unixTimestamp (ms) and displayValue (dateFormat plus the time). defaultValue takes ISO text, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm' or a unix timestamp; minDate/maxDate ('YYYY-MM-DD') and disabledDates (array) block days. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

catalog.name: ShadDialog
catalog.description: Dialog or side sheet (ToolJet Modal in the pack look): header, body and footer canvases (put a ShadHeading and a muted ShadText in the header, the form in the body, ShadButtons in the footer); open and close it with the show-modal / close-modal event actions or its open and close actions; exposed show. Kind "sheet" slides in from the side at full height

catalog.name: ShadDropdownMenu
catalog.description: Dropdown menu: a trigger button (label + variant, or an icon-only '...' trigger) opening a menu of items [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconPencil', description?, shortcut?: '⌘E', disabled?, visible?, destructive?, separator? (line above), group? (heading) }]. On select fires onSelect with lastClickedOption { label, value, description }. Height 36px (sm 32px, lg 40px)

catalog.name: ShadEmpty
catalog.description: Empty state with title, description and an optional action

catalog.name: ShadFileUpload
catalog.description: File upload: a dashed dropzone (drag and drop or click to browse) with a file list. accept is a MIME or extension list like 'image/*,.pdf'; maxSize and minSize in bytes. Exposes file [{ name, type, size, content (text), base64Data, dataURL, parsedData }] like the native File picker. Height: about 160px for the dropzone, 180px with a label; the list adds about 66px per file (dynamic height)

catalog.name: ShadFunnelChart
catalog.description: Funnel of stages in order: data [{ stage: 'Visited', count: 12480 }, { stage: 'Paid', count: 412 }], stageField 'stage', valueField 'count'; one bar per stage sized to the widest, its value, and its conversion % from the stage before (conversionBase 'previous') or from the first ('first'); align center/left, colorByStage (palette per stage, else one colour fading down), yAxisFormat for values. About 44 px per stage; clicking a stage sets clickedDataPoint to its row and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadHeading
catalog.description: Heading (h1 to h4). Typeface styles: fontFamily ('theme', 'sans', 'serif', 'display' or 'mono'), fontWeight (400 to 800), fontSize (px), letterSpacing (px or em) and textTransform ('uppercase' for an eyebrow)

catalog.name: ShadHeatmapChart
catalog.description: Heatmap: a grid of cells shaded by value, for two categories against each other (weekday by hour, region by month). data [{ day: 'Mon', hour: '09:00', tickets: 12 }], yField 'day' (rows), xField 'hour' (columns), valueField 'tickets' (rows landing in the same cell are summed); xOrder / yOrder fix the order (else first appearance); showValues prints each value; a min-to-max legend. Height about 32 px per row plus 40; clicking a cell sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadHero
catalog.description: Page hero at the top of a page: eyebrow (small caps line above), title, subtitle, meta facts (['Sun, 11 Oct', '14 bookings'] or [{ label, value }]), an aside on the right and up to two actions (actionLabel, secondaryActionLabel; onActionClicked, onSecondaryActionClicked). The aside is one headline figure (asideValue 12480 or '$12,480', asideLabel 'Revenue today' above it) or a short list of facts (asideValue [{ label: 'Open', value: 14 }, { label: 'Due today', value: 3 }], up to 4, asideLabel as their heading). Greetings and header facts belong in the hero itself: 'Good morning, Ada' as the title, one line of what needs attention as the subtitle, today's date and counts as meta chips, the one number that matters in the aside; never a separate Text or Stat floating beside or over the header. With an aside, the actions sit under the text. background 'plain' (no panel), 'tint' (a soft panel in the accent), 'gradient' (accent wash), 'image' (imageUrl behind a dark overlay, white text) or 'dark' (deep accent panel, white text); icon (lucide name) in a rounded tile beside the title; align left or center (the aside goes under the text); size compact, default or large. Styles accentColor (else the theme's primary), titleFontFamily ('serif', 'display', ...). Height: grows with its content (about 150px default, 120px compact, 220px large; add 40px for actions under the text)

catalog.name: ShadIcon
catalog.description: Icon: icon is any lucide name ('trending-up' or 'TrendingUp'; unknown names show a neutral dashed circle), size (px), strokeWidth, tone (default, muted, primary, success, warning, destructive) or the iconColor style, chip ('none', 'circle', 'square') for the tinted icon chip of KPI cards (chipColor style, else a tint of the icon colour; chipSize, else size x 2); onClick. Height: 40px with a chip at size 20, else the icon size

catalog.name: ShadImage
catalog.description: Image: source (URL), alternativeText, imageFit (cover, contain, fill), aspectRatio ('auto' fills the drawn height; '16/9', '4/3', '1/1' size it from the width), caption below, fallback when the URL is empty or fails ('placeholder', 'icon', or 'initials' of fallbackText), showBorder, zoomOnClick lightbox; a skeleton shows while it loads; onClick. Height: as drawn with aspect auto (a caption takes 28px of it)

catalog.name: ShadInput
catalog.description: Text input with label. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

catalog.name: ShadKanban
catalog.description: Kanban board from data: columns are values of a status field; cards show the fields you map (title, description, badge, tags, progress, meta, avatar), or, with Card content Custom, child components laid out on the card and bound to {{cardData.<field>}}. Drag to move, optional add and delete buttons, and addCard/updateCardData/deleteCard/moveCard actions; save changes with queries on the card events (components.<name>.lastCardMovement, lastAddedCard, lastRemovedCard, lastUpdatedCard, updatedCardData)

catalog.name: ShadKeyValue
catalog.description: Description list for a record's details: data is an object ({ Status: 'Active', Owner: 'Ada' }) or an array of { label, value, type?, format? } with type text, number, currency, date, badge, link or boolean (format: a date format or { currency, decimalPlaces, prefix, suffix }); columns 1 to 4; layout 'inline' (label beside the value, labelWidth) or 'stacked'; dividers; emptyText for blanks; currency, dateFormat and badgeColors defaults; allowCopy. Height: about 41px per row inline, 69px stacked (per column when columns > 1)

catalog.name: ShadLineChart
catalog.description: Line chart for trends: data [{ month: 'Jan', revenue: 18600, expenses: 8000 }], xField 'month', yFields 'revenue,expenses' (one line each); curve monotone/linear/step, dots, strokeWidth, dashedFields, an optional target line (referenceValue, referenceLabel) and yAxisFormat number/currency/percent/compact. Height 200-320 px; clicking a point sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadLink
catalog.description: Text link (native Link names): linkText, linkTarget (URL; empty makes it act as a button), targetType ('new' or 'same' tab), underline ('underline', 'on-hover', 'no-underline'), showIcon (external-link icon), fontSize (px), fontWeight (normal, medium, semibold, bold); textColor and hoverColor styles (default: the primary). onClick fires as well as navigating; onHover. Height: 24px at 14px

catalog.name: ShadListView
catalog.description: List or grid: one canvas repeated per item of data; parent components to it and bind them to {{listItem.<field>}}. A click selects the item (selectedItem, selectedRecord; onRecordClicked); optional pagination (client or server side), dividers, hover and selected highlight. Items have a fixed height (rowHeight)

catalog.name: ShadMap
catalog.description: Map with markers from rows, on open map tiles (no API key): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, listings, incidents. data: rows read through latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates, or at exactly 0, 0, are skipped and counted in a footnote), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the address), statusField and idField. Pins are coloured by status: by its words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed or Pending amber, Failed or Overdue red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info), or by statusColors ({ 'Under offer': '#d97706', Open: 'warning' }); showLegend (on) lists the colours with counts. labelField puts a short value in the pin (a stop number) or, longer, a price pill ('€450k'); iconField puts a lucide icon in the pin ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap'). Routes: connectMarkers draws a line through the markers in routeOrderField order, one per routeField value (a driver, a van), from routeStart (a depot { lat, lng }) when given; routes (a second dataset) draws lines from rows { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, color or status }; routeColors names each line's colour. Areas (zones, territories, geofences): areas rows with an outline (areaShapeField: [[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or its JSON text) or a circle (lat, lng and areaRadiusField in metres), titled by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (or the row's color). A click on a marker selects it (selectedMarker: its row, selectedMarkerId), opens a popup with the title, status and popupFields (a comma list of field specs as the Record list's metaFields: 'driver', 'eta:ETA {}', 'total|currency'; showPopup off for none) and fires onMarkerClick; a click on a line or area exposes selectedShape (its row) and selectedShapeType ('route' | 'area') and fires onShapeClicked; a click on the map clears the selection, exposes clickedLocation { lat, lng } and fires onMapClicked. pickLocation lets the user click (or drag a pin) to choose a spot: pickedLocation { lat, lng, address } and onLocationPicked (defaultPickedLocation starts it); showSearch adds an address search box (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default, rate-limited; geocoderUrl and reverseGeocoderUrl, with {query} or {lat} and {lng}, point it at another geocoder). display 'heat' (or 'both') draws density instead of pins, weighted by heatField. clusterMarkers groups crowded pins into counts (on by default; keeps thousands of rows smooth). fitToMarkers (on by default) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, the map opens on defaultCenter ({ lat, lng }, [lat, lng] or 'lat, lng') at defaultZoom (1 to 18; 12 is a city, 15 a street). scrollWheelZoom is off by default (the page scrolls past the map; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen adds a fullscreen button; mapStyle 'satellite' shows imagery and showStyleSwitch a Map | Satellite toggle. Exposes center, zoom and bounds after every move; onBoundsChange fires when the user pans or zooms. Actions: setCenter(lat, lng, zoom), setZoom, fitBounds, selectMarker(id), clearSelection, setPickedLocation(lat, lng), clearPickedLocation, setMapStyle('streets' | 'satellite'). Height: fixed (the map fills it); give it 320 to 640px

catalog.name: ShadMultiselect
catalog.description: Multi-select combobox: picked options show as removable chips in the field (+N past maxVisibleChips), with search and select all. options like the Combobox; defaultValue is an array of values; exposes values (array) and selectedOptions. Height: 64px with a label, 36px without (one row of chips; grows with dynamic height)

catalog.name: ShadNavigation
catalog.description: App navigation: a vertical sidebar list or a horizontal top bar from items [{ label, value, icon?: 'IconHome', badge?, disabled?, group? (sidebar heading), children?: [{ label, value }] }] (children open as a dropdown in the top bar, a nested list in the sidebar). variant pills, underline or ghost; defaultValue is the active item; onClick fires on click with exposed value and selectedItem { label, value, parentLabel, parentValue } (wire page switches here); selectItem(value). Item height 36px; a top bar is 40px tall, a sidebar fills the widget's height

catalog.name: ShadNumberInput
catalog.description: Number input: value is a number (null when empty), rounded to decimalPlaces; step buttons (stepper: split -/+ at both ends, stacked arrows at the right, or none) and ArrowUp/ArrowDown move by step and stop at the Min/Max value validation; optional prefix/suffix text inside the box (e.g. '$', 'kg') and thousands separators. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

catalog.name: ShadOtpInput
catalog.description: One-time code input: length (4 to 8) character boxes, numeric or alphanumeric (upper-cased), typing moves to the next box, Backspace goes back, pasting a whole code fills it ('123-456' works). Optional separator in the middle and masked dots. Exposes value and isComplete; onComplete fires when the last box is filled (verify there). Boxes are 36px (slotSize style); height 64px with a label, 36px without

catalog.name: ShadPagination
catalog.description: Pagination (native Pagination names): numberOfPages, or totalRecords with pageSize; defaultPageIndex (1-based); Previous / page numbers with ellipsis / Next (showLabels), optional first and last buttons (showFirstLast), siblingCount, size 'sm' or 'default'. onPageChange; action setPage(page); exposed currentPageIndex (1-based) and totalPages. Bind a query offset to (currentPageIndex - 1) * pageSize. Height: 36px (32px small)

catalog.name: ShadPasswordInput
catalog.description: Password input with a show/hide eye button (showToggle) and an optional strength meter (showStrength: a three-part weak/fair/strong bar under the box, exposed as strength = '' | 'weak' | 'fair' | 'strong'). Validate with the text rules (mandatory, regex, min length). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message; the strength meter adds 16px

catalog.name: ShadPhoneInput
catalog.description: Phone number input: a country picker (flag and calling code; searchable list) attached to the number box, which formats as you type. Exposes value (E.164, e.g. '+14155550123', '' when empty), country ('US'), countryCode ('+1'), formattedValue ('+1 415 555 0123') and isValidNumber; isValid is false for an invalid number. defaultCountry is an ISO code; onlyCountries limits the list (['US', 'CA']). Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

catalog.name: ShadPieChart
catalog.description: Pie or donut chart with an optional center figure

catalog.name: ShadProgressList
catalog.description: List of progress rows from data, for goals, budgets, quotas, onboarding steps and capacity: each row has a label (labelField), its value against a target ('$18,400 of $25,000': valueField, targetField, in valueFormat: auto, number, currency in currency, percent, compact), a progress bar, an optional status (statusField: a chip toned by its words, On track green, At risk amber, Over budget or Behind red; a status that only names a tone, success, warning, danger, info or neutral, colours the bar without a chip) and an optional trailing caption under the bar ('12 days left': captionField). The percentage is percentField when the data has one (0 to 100), else value / target; a row with a value and no target reads the value as the percentage. autoTone colours bars from their percentage when the row has no status: 'goal' green at 100%, 'limit' (budgets, quotas, storage) amber from 80% and red over 100%. showValues and showPercent pick the figures shown; barSize thin, default or thick; listStyle 'card' (bordered panel) or 'plain'. A click on a row exposes selectedItem and selectedItemId and fires onItemClicked (rows look clickable only when it is handled). Use a Stat or a Summary strip for one headline figure, a Progress for a single bar. Height: grows with its rows (about 64px a row, 76px with captions)

catalog.name: ShadQuestionnaire
catalog.description: ToolJet UI 2.0 multi-step questionnaire, one question at a time: a 'Question 2 of 5' progress bar, the prompt and description, answer cards with a letter (or number) shortcut, and Previous, Skip (optional questions), Next and Submit. items: [{ name, prompt, description, required, type: 'single' | 'multiple' | 'text', choices: ['Label'] or [{ label, value, description }], other: true or { label, placeholder } (a free-text Other answer), placeholder (text), multiline: false (a one-line text answer: a name, an email) }]. A required question blocks Next with an error until answered. Exposes answers ({ [name]: value, multiple as an array, Other as its text }), currentIndex, currentItem and isComplete; onStepChanged on every move, onSubmit with the answers (run the save query there). After submit it shows completeTitle and completeText. Actions reset() and goTo(index or name). defaultAnswers restores saved answers. Height: grows with the question (about 440px for four choices, 160px plus 58px per choice)

catalog.name: ShadRadarChart
catalog.description: Radar (spider) chart comparing scores across categories: data [{ skill: 'Speed', alex: 86, jordan: 65 }], categoryField 'skill' (one spoke per row), yFields 'alex,jordan' (one filled polygon each); fillOpacity, gridShape polygon/circle, dots, legend, maxValue (blank = auto). Best square, 240-320 px; clicking sets clickedDataPoint and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadRadialChart
catalog.description: Radial bar chart. Mode 'progress': one value against maxValue as a ring with a large centre figure (centerValue, blank = the value) and centerLabel. Mode 'categories': concentric bars from data [{ channel: 'Direct', visitors: 275 }] with categoryField and valueField, a row's fill or color wins. startAngle/endAngle in degrees (90/-270 full ring, 180/0 semicircle gauge); thickness in px. Ring 160-240 px square, gauge about twice as wide as tall.

catalog.name: ShadRadioGroup
catalog.description: Radio group. A label adds 22px above and help text 24px below

catalog.name: ShadRating
catalog.description: Rating: a row of 1 to 10 icons (star, heart or circle) with optional half steps and read-only mode; keyboard accessible. Exposes value (number, 0 for none). Height: 24px for the default size (32px for lg), plus 22px with a label

catalog.name: ShadRecordList
catalog.description: List of records as two-line rows, for a recent-orders, people, tickets or activity panel beside a chart or a table: an avatar (avatarField: an image URL, else the initials of that field's text, else of the title), the title (titleField), a meta line under it (metaFields, a comma list of field specs joined with ' · ': 'city', 'total|currency', 'due|date:Due {}' (value in a label), 'seats:Seats' (label first); formats number, currency, percent, compact, date, datetime), a progress bar under the meta line (progressField: a percentage 0 to 100, as 42 or '42%'; onboarding, a project's completion), a status chip on the right (statusField, toned by its words: Paid green, Pending amber, Overdue red, Open blue) and a trailing value (valueField in valueFormat: currency in currency, date, number, ...). density compact, default or comfortable; showDividers; listStyle 'card' (bordered panel) or 'plain'; avatarShape circle or rounded. A click selects the row (selectedItem, selectedItemId; onItemClicked). Draws 100 rows and a Show more button. Height: grows with its rows (about 60px a row at default density)

catalog.name: ShadScatterChart
catalog.description: Scatter or bubble chart relating two measures: data [{ account: 'Globex', spend: 30, revenue: 95, seats: 120, segment: 'Enterprise' }], xField 'spend', yField 'revenue', optional sizeField (bubbles), groupField (one colour and legend entry per value), nameField (tooltip title), xLabel/yLabel axis titles, referenceX/referenceY dashed quadrant lines, x and y formats. Height 260-360 px; clicking a point sets clickedDataPoint to its row and fires onClick.

catalog.name: ShadSchedule
catalog.description: Resource schedule: resources down the side (rooms, desks, people on shift or on call, vehicles, equipment) and time across, with bookings drawn as blocks. scale 'hours' shows one day (date, empty for today) from dayStart to dayEnd (hours, 0 to 24) with empty slots of slotMinutes; scale 'days' shows `days` days from date (a week of shifts, an on-call rota). resources: ['Atlas', 'Cove'] or [{ id, name, caption, avatar }] (empty: the distinct values of the bookings' resourceField). bookings: rows read through startField and endField (an ISO date-time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', 'HH:mm' for a time on the shown day, or 'YYYY-MM-DD' for a whole day; no end lasts an hour), resourceField (a resource's id or name), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the host, the person) and statusField (toned by its words: Confirmed green, Tentative or Pending amber, Cancelled red, Booked blue; or a tone name). Overlapping bookings of one resource stack in lanes. A now-line marks the current time on today (showNowLine). A click on a booking exposes selectedBooking (its row) and selectedBookingId and fires onBookingClicked; a click on an empty slot exposes selectedSlot { resourceId, resource, start, end (ISO), date, startTime, endTime, label } and fires onSlotClicked (open a booking form from it). hourFormat 12h or 24h; resourceTitle heads the resource column. Scrolls sideways when the hours do not fit. Height: grows with its rows (40px header plus rowHeight, default 56, per resource; more where bookings overlap)

catalog.name: ShadSelect
catalog.description: Select. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

catalog.name: ShadSlider
catalog.description: Slider, single value or range. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text

catalog.name: ShadSparkline
catalog.description: Tiny line or area trend for KPI cards, no axes or grid: data [12, 18, 15, 22] or [{ x: 'Mon', y: 12 }]; type line/area, curve, end dot, colorByTrend (last vs first value, positiveColor/negativeColor styles; lowerIsBetter flips it), optional min/max band. Height 24-64 px (40 typical), placed under a Stat; exposes trend ('up' | 'down' | 'flat') and lastValue.

catalog.name: ShadSpinner
catalog.description: Loading spinner: variant ('ring', 'dots'), size ('sm' 16px, 'default' 24px, 'lg' 32px, or px), optional label with labelPosition ('right' beside, 'bottom' below); spinnerColor style (default: the primary). Height: 24px with the label beside (32px for lg), 52px with it below

catalog.name: ShadStat
catalog.description: Dashboard figure, from a single number to a full KPI card: label, value (a number groups its digits; valueFormat currency in currency, percent or compact formats it), change badge (change, trend) with a context line (changeLabel, e.g. 'vs last month'), footnote; optional icon (any lucide name, iconPosition right, left or top, iconStyle square, circle or none), trendData for a small trend line under the figure (numbers or [{ x, y }]), progress (0 to 100) with progressLabel for a target bar, and size sm, default or lg. Each part shows only when set. Styles valueFontFamily ('serif', 'display', 'mono', ...), labelTextTransform ('uppercase') and labelLetterSpacing ('0.1em') set the figure's typeface and a small-caps label

catalog.name: ShadSteps
catalog.description: Stepper (native Steps names): steps [{ id, name, description?, visible?, disabled?, tooltip? }]; currentStep is the current step's id; numbered circles (variant 'dots' for small dots), check marks on completed steps, connecting lines; orientation 'horizontal' or 'vertical'. stepsSelectable lets users click a step (onSelect; exposed currentStepId, currentStepIndex). Actions setStep(id), nextStep, previousStep, resetSteps, setStepVisible(id, visible), setStepDisable(id, disabled). Height: 60px horizontal (78px with descriptions); vertical about 66px per step

catalog.name: ShadSummaryStrip
catalog.description: Strip of 3 to 6 headline figures in one row with hairline separators (no card per figure), to sit above or beside a table or a chart: items [{ label, value, format, delta, deltaFormat, tone, lowerIsBetter, caption }] (at most 6 shown). value formats in the item's format, else valueFormat (auto: currency for money labels such as Revenue or Average order, a grouped number otherwise; number, currency in currency, percent, compact, date). delta: a number is signed and shown in deltaFormat (percent: 12.5 shows +12.5%; number; currency), text shows as written ('+3 this week'); its colour is the item's tone (positive, negative, neutral), else its sign (up green, down red; lowerIsBetter flips it for churn, refunds, wait times). caption is a small line under the figure ('vs last month'). appearance 'panel' (one bordered panel) or 'plain'; size sm, default or lg; align left or center. Narrow widths wrap figures into rows. Height: about 90px (sm 70px, lg 110px) a row, plus 18px with captions

catalog.name: ShadTable
catalog.description: Superseded for new builds: use Table with styles.tableLook "shadcn" (ToolJet\

catalog.name: ShadTabs
catalog.description: Tabs: a container with one canvas per tab (parent the tab content with slot_name tab-<id>). Variants: pills (the default), underline, or steps (a wizard with Back/Next/Finish buttons)

catalog.name: ShadTags
catalog.description: Read-only tag chips: tags is an array or a comma-separated string; tagColors maps a value to a colour ({ Paid: '#16a34a' }: tinted chip, light background and strong text of that hue); variant ('soft', 'outline', 'solid'), size ('sm', 'default', 'lg'), overflow ('wrap', or 'single' for one line with +N), pill. Clicking a tag sets lastClickedTag and fires onTagClicked. Height: 24px per line

catalog.name: ShadTagsInput
catalog.description: Tags input: free-form tags typed in the field (Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last, x removes one), with optional suggestions, maxTags, duplicate check and a per-tag pattern. Exposes values (array of text). Height: 64px with a label, 36px without (one row; grows with dynamic height)

catalog.name: ShadText
catalog.description: Paragraph, lead, muted or small text. Typeface styles: fontFamily ('theme', 'sans', 'serif', 'display' or 'mono'), fontWeight, fontSize (px), letterSpacing (px or em) and textTransform (a small uppercase eyebrow: tone small, textTransform 'uppercase', letterSpacing '0.12em')

catalog.name: ShadTextarea
catalog.description: Multi-line input with label. A label adds 22px above and help text 24px below

catalog.name: ShadTimeline
catalog.description: Vertical timeline / activity feed: items [{ title, description, time, status or color, icon? }] (status words such as done, active, pending, failed take theme colours; statusColors maps your own); marker ('dot' or 'icon' with lucide names); density ('comfortable', 'compact'); newestFirst; timePosition ('right', 'top'); dateFormat for ISO times. Clicking an item sets lastClickedItem and fires onItemClicked. Height: about 66px per item with a description (44px without), 50px compact

catalog.name: ShadTimePicker
catalog.description: Time picker: a field opening hour, minute (every minuteStep) and AM/PM columns, or (pickerStyle list) one list of times. Exposes value as 'HH:mm' in 24-hour time ('' when empty) and formattedValue as shown ('2:30 PM' or '14:30'); defaultValue, minTime and maxTime take '14:30' or '2:30 PM'. Height: 64px with a label (label above the control), 36px without; add 24px for help text or a validation message

catalog.name: ShadToggleGroup
catalog.description: Segmented toggle (filters, views), like a tabs list

catalog.name: TagsInput
catalog.description: Tag input with create, select, and delete functionality
